parakeet: Before we leave today, I want to talk about the high cost of unchecked bias. All these mental traps aren't just personal glitches. They've shaped the worst chapters of our shared story. Confirmation bias drove witch hunts across Europe and New England. Motivated reasoning fueled propaganda in two world wars, turning entire nations into echo chambers of hate. From Jim Crow laws to exclusionary immigration bans, echo chambers have written laws that hurt millions simply because a loud majority decided those stories felt true.
